description: Top Status Bar + Session Page Navigation in AssistantView
steps: In src/components/app/CheatingDaddyApp.js: Add a thin session status bar at the top of the content area (below the existing live-bar or replacing parts of it) when session is active. Height: 28px. Left side: green dot + 'Active'. Center: provider/model name. Right: elapsed time in MM:SS format (ticking via the existing timer). Style with existing CSS vars. This can be integrated into the existing renderLiveBar() or added as a separate element.

In src/components/views/AssistantView.js: Track conversation 'pages' as an array of message arrays. Add keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+Shift+Right creates a new page if current page has messages, Ctrl+Shift+Left goes to previous page. Show page indicator (e.g. 'Page 2/3') in the UI. Guard: don't create a new page if the current page is empty.
acceptance_criteria: A thin status bar shows at top of content area during active session with green dot, Active text, provider/model, and ticking elapsed time
Ctrl+Shift+Right creates new conversation page when current has messages
Page indicator shows current page number and total
Cannot create new page if current page is empty
